column1: # What SysuiModule hooks (hook) and reaches by reflection around a hook (uses), by group: a group
# goes in whole or not at all. Read by SystemUI at its start (TargetTable.kt, packed at the root
# of the APK) and by tools/hook_targets.py against a SystemUI APK and framework.jar, with the same
# rules. Columns: group, kind, class, member, signature. Signature: the exact dex parameter list
# "(...)" (any return type), "-" for a field. The class is the one that declares the member. A
# member ending in "$*" matches its bare name or that name and one suffix (R8's applyState$1, a
# Kotlin module's isDragDownEnabledForView$<module>), and only when exactly one method of the
# class has it with these parameters; a constructor is "<init>". Targets LineageOS 24; the groups off there (placecall,
# splash) keep the BenOS rows the L6 lots rewrite. A hook
# outside this table is refused at install (SysuiModule.install): its group goes off.
